_comment: The canteen (Milestone 21, third version, decisions 65 and 66, MILESTONE_21.md). The player chooses good food or fast food, then builds a plate of up to canteen.plate_max foods of that kind from many examples, so players learn to tell them apart. Kinds are not mixed, so a good plate is exactly the healthy meal and a fast-food plate exactly the fast-food meal (meal_for, data/foods.json): the health model is unchanged. Milestone 40 (documentation/ui_v2/changes.md, change 12, 21 Nov 2026): the ten good foods are the team's (mockup 07), and the fast foods are the team's eight (ice cream added; nuggets, kebab and milkshake removed); two more fast foods come later from the team. Every food has the team's picture, assets/art/food/<id>.png, so the placeholder colour is gone (a food added without a picture needs a "color" again: the tile then shows its first letter on that colour). name: a key of translations/strings.csv.
